title: Pullback of local isomorphisms with canonical unit normalization
statement: theorem exists_tensorPullback_over_iso_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (M N : Y.Modules) (e : M.over U ≅ N.over U) : ∃ t : ((tensorPullback f).obj M).over (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≅ ((tensorPullback f).obj N).over (f ⁻¹ᵁ U), ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (h : V ≤ U) (s : M.val.obj (op V)), t.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (f.preimage_mono h)))) (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app M).val.app (op V) s) = ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)).unit.app N).val.app (op V) (e.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h))) s)

source.place: Lemma 6.26.2 and naturality of the pullback adjunction unit

proof.text: Reuse the existing private overAdjunction_counit_isIso theorem from TensorUnitOpenLocalization with a proof-only import all. The triangle identity makes restriction of each localization unit invertible. Apply tensorPullback_map_over_isIso to these units for M and N.

Construct t by composing the pulled-back localization unit for M, pullback of S(e), and the inverse pulled-back localization unit for N. Naturality of e along U intersect V to V proves compatibility of S(e) with localization of sections. Naturality of the canonical pullback unit for the three maps, followed by cancellation of the final invertible map, proves the required normalization.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.26.2 and naturality of the pullback adjunction unit
